subject: Regional SI onboarding — EdgeWorks / data residency & controls
messages:
From: Emma Lopez <emma@edgeworks.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Intro — EdgeWorks SI onboarding for APAC/EU customers

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking a look — I lead partnerships at EdgeWorks Consulting and we are working with a couple of enterprise financial services customers that need local integrators for APAC and EU deployments. They care a lot about data residency, tenant isolation, and customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).

Attached is a short SOW draft so you can see the scope we usually propose (EdgeWorks_SOW_draft.pdf). High level asks from customers:
- On-prem or VPC private deployment options in EU and Japan/KR regions
- Proof of data-at-rest residency per tenant and export controls
- KMS/HSM integration or BYOK options
- A simple mutual action plan and timeline to production (6–8 weeks for pilot)

Are these things Redwood supports for partners in a reseller + SI model, and what documents do you normally need up front? Would love to set a short call next week (30m).

Best,
Emma Lopez
Partnerships, EdgeWorks Consulting
Attachments: EdgeWorks_SOW_draft.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lopez <emma@edgeworks.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 13:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Intro — EdgeWorks SI onboarding for APAC/EU customers

Emma — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the SOW. Short answers up front: yes, we support private deployments (VPC and on-prem) and tenant-level data residency in EU regions and APAC (Japan, Singapore). We also support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations and HSM in our Private product.

Quick next steps I propose:
1) Alignment call (30m) this week to confirm pilot scope + timelines
2) Exchange compliance artifacts: SOC2 summary, EU data residency guide (we can share)
3) Mutual action plan + redline of the reseller/SI addendum (I can share a template)

Sergio / Marissa — tagging you for technical + partner ops alignment. Sergio: can you confirm the standard BYOK options we present to partners and the typical lead time for HSM provisioning? Marissa: I will need a partner enablement checklist we can send to EdgeWorks.

Emma — are any of the customers regulated (PSD2/GLBA/JP FISC) or do they have stricter DSA requirements? That will determine whether we need on-prem vs VPC in-country.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: hiro_tanaka <hiro@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 08:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Intro — EdgeWorks SI onboarding for APAC/EU customers

Vanessa / Marissa — quick technical notes for the call:
- BYOK: we support cloud KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and an HSM-backed workflow for Private deployments. HSM provisioning for a new partner environment typically takes 2–4 weeks if hardware is required.
- Data residency: our Private control plane supports tenant scoping and per-tenant encryption keys. For EU customers we recommend a VPC + regional storage to satisfy residency; for stringent regulators we recommend an on-prem package (air-gapped) and additional audit steps.
- Contracts: ask Legal for a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and a Data Transfer Addendum — these are standard but sometimes need local legal review (JP/EU).

Action items for call:
- Vanessa: confirm whether EdgeWorks needs Redwood to act as a reseller or purely as a runtime provider (this changes commercial flows).
- Marissa: prepare partner enablement checklist and partner SSO + support matrix.
- Hiro / Karthik: be ready to discuss timelines and a pilot architecture diagram on the call.

I will also ask Compliance to push a redacted SOC2 summary to the thread after the call.

Thanks,
Sergio
Director, Partnerships Engineering
From: DataTrust EU <compliance@datatrust.eu>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: emma@edgeworks.com
Date: Sat, 13 Sep 2025 09:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Regional SI onboarding — SOC2 & residency artifacts

Hi Vanessa / Sergio / Emma,

Thanks for looping DataTrust EU in. Attached are two artifacts that should answer most initial questions: a redacted SOC2 summary and our EU data residency playbook (DataTrust_SOC2_summary.pdf, eu-data-residency-playbook.pdf).

Key clarifications:
- SOC2: our summary covers controls around encryption-in-transit and at-rest, access logging, and third-party vendor assessments. We can provide a full SOC2 report under an NDA if required.
- Residency: for customer-level residency we recommend tenant-level encryption keys + region-bound storage. For export controls we add an audit log that records data egress attempts; that log can be surfaced to the customer's auditors.
- KMS/HSM: BYOK is standard for enterprise. For HSM-backed key storage we require coordination on key rotation windows and an HSM onboarding checklist.

We can do a joint call next Tue (16 Sep) with your compliance/legal teams. Please share preferred times.

Regards,
Marta Delgado
Head of Compliance — DataTrust EU
Attachments: DataTrust_SOC2_summary.pdf, eu-data-residency-playbook.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: emma@edgeworks.com, sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, hiro_tanaka <hiro@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, compliance@datatrust.eu
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Regional SI onboarding — EdgeWorks / next steps and MAP

All — thanks for the quick coordination. Summary and agreed next steps below:

Summary decisions:
- Pilot model: VPC-based Private deployment in EU (single-tenant per customer) with tenant-scoped storage. For Japan customer, evaluate VPC vs on-prem once we have regulatory posture.
- Keys: BYOK via customer KMS for pilot; HSM option scoped as part of production readiness (2–4 week lead).
- Artifacts: DataTrust provided SOC2 summary and residency playbook — thanks Marta. We will share a redacted SOC2 from Redwood under NDA if EdgeWorks' customers request it.

Action items (owners / due):
- Vanessa: send mutual_action_plan.xlsx (pilot milestones + success criteria) — due Wed 2025-09-17 (attached).
- Marissa: partner enablement checklist + SSO doc — due Mon 2025-09-22.
- Sergio / Hiro: pilot architecture diagram and HSM onboarding checklist — due Mon 2025-09-22.
- Emma / EdgeWorks: confirm whether EdgeWorks will be reseller (commercial flow) or pure SI by 2025-09-18.
- Legal: Redwood to circulate redline_contract_v2.docx for reseller addendum (Vanessa to share) — internal review requested.

Emma — propose we do a short alignment call Thursday 2025-09-18 14:00 UTC to lock down pilot scope; let me know if that works.

Thanks everyone — attaching the mutual action plan and initial redline for tracking.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
